124inline bool IsSubsurfaceShadingModel(FMaterialShadingModelField ShadingModel)
125{
126 return ShadingModel.HasShadingModel(MSM_Subsurface) || ShadingModel.HasShadingModel(MSM_PreintegratedSkin) ||
127 ShadingModel.HasShadingModel(MSM_SubsurfaceProfile) || ShadingModel.HasShadingModel(MSM_TwoSidedFoliage) ||
128 ShadingModel.HasShadingModel(MSM_Cloth) || ShadingModel.HasShadingModel(MSM_Eye);
129}
130
131inline bool UseSubsurfaceProfile(FMaterialShadingModelField ShadingModel)
132{
133 return ShadingModel.HasShadingModel(MSM_SubsurfaceProfile) || ShadingModel.HasShadingModel(MSM_Eye);
134}
135
136inline uint32 GetUseSubsurfaceProfileShadingModelMask()
137{
138 return (1u << MSM_SubsurfaceProfile) | (1u << MSM_Eye) | (Substrate::IsSubstrateEnabled() ? (1u << MSM_PreintegratedSkin) : 0u);
139}

210inline uint32 GetNumComponents(EMaterialValueType Type)
211{
212 switch (Type)
213 {
214 case MCT_UInt:
215 case MCT_UInt1:
216 case MCT_Float:
217 case MCT_Float1: return 1;
218 case MCT_UInt2:
219 case MCT_Float2: return 2;
220 case MCT_UInt3:
221 case MCT_Float3: return 3;
222 case MCT_UInt4:
223 case MCT_Float4: return 4;
224 case MCT_LWCScalar: return 1;
225 case MCT_LWCVector2: return 2;
226 case MCT_LWCVector3: return 3;
227 case MCT_LWCVector4: return 4;
228 case MCT_StaticBool: return 1;
229 case MCT_Bool: return 1;
230 default: return 0;
231 }
232}
233
234inline bool IsMaterialValueType(EMaterialValueType InType, EMaterialValueType InCompare)
235{
236 return (InType & InCompare) != 0;
237}
238
239inline bool IsLWCType(EMaterialValueType InType)
240{
241 return IsMaterialValueType(InType, MCT_LWCType);
242}
243
244inline bool IsFloatNumericType(EMaterialValueType InType)
245{
246 return IsMaterialValueType(InType, EMaterialValueType(MCT_Float | MCT_LWCType));
247}
248
249inline bool IsUIntNumericType(EMaterialValueType InType)
250{
251 return IsMaterialValueType(InType, MCT_UInt);
252}
253
254inline bool IsNumericType(EMaterialValueType InType)
255{
256 // 'ShadingModel' is considered an 'int'
257 return IsMaterialValueType(InType, EMaterialValueType(MCT_Float | MCT_LWCType | MCT_UInt | MCT_ShadingModel));
258}
259
260inline bool IsPrimitiveType(EMaterialValueType InType)
261{
262 // 'ShadingModel' is considered an 'int'
263 return IsMaterialValueType(InType, EMaterialValueType(MCT_Float | MCT_LWCType | MCT_UInt | MCT_ShadingModel | MCT_Bool | MCT_StaticBool));
264}
265
266inline EMaterialValueType MakeNonLWCType(EMaterialValueType Type)
267{
268 switch (Type)
269 {
270 case MCT_LWCScalar: return MCT_Float1;
271 case MCT_LWCVector2: return MCT_Float2;
272 case MCT_LWCVector3: return MCT_Float3;
273 case MCT_LWCVector4: return MCT_Float4;
274 default: return Type;
275 }
276}
277
278inline EMaterialValueType MakeLWCType(EMaterialValueType Type)
279{
280 switch (Type)
281 {
282 case MCT_Float: return MCT_LWCScalar;
283 case MCT_Float1: return MCT_LWCScalar;
284 case MCT_Float2: return MCT_LWCVector2;
285 case MCT_Float3: return MCT_LWCVector3;
286 case MCT_Float4: return MCT_LWCVector4;
287 default: return Type;
288 }
289}

383class FMaterialVirtualTextureStack
384{
385 DECLARE_TYPE_LAYOUT(FMaterialVirtualTextureStack, NonVirtual);
386public:
387 FMaterialVirtualTextureStack();
389 FMaterialVirtualTextureStack(int32 InPreallocatedStackTextureIndex);
390
392 uint32 AddLayer();
394 uint32 SetLayer(int32 LayerIndex, int32 UniformExpressionIndex);
396 inline uint32 GetNumLayers() const { return NumLayers; }
398 inline bool AreLayersFull() const { return NumLayers == VIRTUALTEXTURE_SPACE_MAXLAYERS; }
400 int32 FindLayer(int32 UniformExpressionIndex) const;
401
403 inline bool IsPreallocatedStack() const { return PreallocatedStackTextureIndex != INDEX_NONE; }
405 void GetTextureValues(const FMaterialRenderContext& Context, const FUniformExpressionSet& UniformExpressionSet, UTexture const** OutValues) const;
407 void GetTextureValue(const FMaterialRenderContext& Context, const FUniformExpressionSet& UniformExpressionSet, const URuntimeVirtualTexture*& OutValue) const;
409 void GetTextureValue(const FMaterialRenderContext& Context, const FUniformExpressionSet& UniformExpressionSet, const USparseVolumeTexture * &OutValue) const;
410
411 void Serialize(FArchive& Ar);
412
413 friend FArchive& operator<<(FArchive& Ar, FMaterialVirtualTextureStack& Stack)
414 {
415 Stack.Serialize(Ar);
416 return Ar;
417 }
418
419 friend bool operator==(const FMaterialVirtualTextureStack& Lhs, const FMaterialVirtualTextureStack& Rhs)
420 {
421 if (Lhs.PreallocatedStackTextureIndex != Rhs.PreallocatedStackTextureIndex || Lhs.NumLayers != Rhs.NumLayers)
422 {
423 return false;
424 }
425 for (uint32 i = 0u; i < Lhs.NumLayers; ++i)
426 {
427 if (Lhs.LayerUniformExpressionIndices[i] != Rhs.LayerUniformExpressionIndices[i])
428 {
429 return false;
430 }
431 }
432 // Note: ShaderFrequencyMask is intentionally ignored — it only affects the editor-side decision to include the parameter in the VS compact uniform buffer.
433 return true;
434 }
435
436 friend inline bool operator!=(const FMaterialVirtualTextureStack& Lhs, const FMaterialVirtualTextureStack& Rhs)
437 {
438 return !operator==(Lhs, Rhs);
439 }
440
442 LAYOUT_FIELD(uint32, NumLayers);
444 LAYOUT_ARRAY(int32, LayerUniformExpressionIndices, VIRTUALTEXTURE_SPACE_MAXLAYERS);
446 LAYOUT_FIELD(int32, PreallocatedStackTextureIndex);
447 LAYOUT_FIELD_EDITORONLY(EShaderFrequencyMask, ShaderFrequencyMask);
448};

930 bool IsSceneTextureUsed(ESceneTextureId TexId) const { return (UsedSceneTextures & (1 << TexId)) != 0; }
931
932 void SetIsSceneTextureUsed(ESceneTextureId TexId)
933 {
934 // User scene textures aren't added to used bits -- those are stored separately in UserSceneTextureInputs
935 if (TexId < PPI_UserSceneTexture0)
936 {
937 UsedSceneTextures |= (1 << TexId);
938 }
939 }
940
941#if WITH_EDITOR
942 // Returns Id for a user scene texture input, or INDEX_NONE if allocation fails.
943 int32 FindOrAddUserSceneTexture(FName UserSceneTexture);
944
945 // Returns Id for a user scene texture input, or INDEX_NONE if not found.
946 int32 FindUserSceneTexture(FName UserSceneTexture) const;
947
948 // Returns number of post process inputs used, between PostProcessInput SceneTexture nodes and UserSceneTexture nodes. If this exceeds
949 // kPostProcessMaterialInputCountMax, compile should be failed (number is returned rather than bool for error reporting purposes).
950 int32 GetNumPostProcessInputsUsed() const;
951#endif // WITH_EDITOR
952
953 void SetIsDBufferTextureUsed(int32 TextureIndex) { UsedDBufferTextures |= (1 << TextureIndex); }
954 void SetIsDBufferTextureLookupUsed(bool bValue) { bUsesDBufferTextureLookup = bValue; }
955
956 void SetIsPathTracingBufferTextureUsed(int32 TexId) { UsedPathTracingBufferTextures |= (1 << TexId); }
957
959 bool RequiresSceneColorCopy() const { return IsSceneTextureUsed(PPI_SceneColor); }
960
962 static uint32 GetGBufferMask()
963 {
964 return
965 (1u << PPI_DiffuseColor) |
966 (1u << PPI_SpecularColor) |
967 (1u << PPI_SubsurfaceColor) |
968 (1u << PPI_BaseColor) |
969 (1u << PPI_Specular) |
970 (1u << PPI_Metallic) |
971 (1u << PPI_WorldNormal) |
972 (1u << PPI_WorldTangent) |
973 (1u << PPI_Opacity) |
974 (1u << PPI_Roughness) |
975 (1u << PPI_Anisotropy) |
976 (1u << PPI_MaterialAO) |
977 (1u << PPI_DecalMask) |
978 (1u << PPI_ShadingModelColor) |
979 (1u << PPI_ShadingModelID) |
980 (1u << PPI_StoredBaseColor) |
981 (1u << PPI_StoredSpecular) |
982 (1u << PPI_Velocity) |
983 (1u << PPI_IsFirstPerson);
984 }
985
987 bool NeedsGBuffer() const
988 {
989 return UsedSceneTextures & GetGBufferMask();
990 }
991
993 bool UsesSceneDepthLookup() const { return IsSceneTextureUsed(PPI_SceneDepth); }
994
996 bool UsesVelocitySceneTexture() const { return IsSceneTextureUsed(PPI_Velocity); }

1903

2054class FMaterialExpressionKey
2055{
2056public:
2057 UMaterialExpression* Expression;
2058 int32 OutputIndex;
2060 FGuid MaterialAttributeID;
2061 // Expressions are different (e.g. ResolvedView.PrevWorldViewOrigin) when using previous frame's values, value if from FHLSLMaterialTranslator::bCompilingPreviousFrame
2062 bool bCompilingPreviousFrameKey;
2063
2064 FMaterialExpressionKey(UMaterialExpression* InExpression, int32 InOutputIndex) :
2065 Expression(InExpression),
2066 OutputIndex(InOutputIndex),
2067 MaterialAttributeID(FGuid(0,0,0,0)),
2068 bCompilingPreviousFrameKey(false)
2069 {}
2070
2071 FMaterialExpressionKey(UMaterialExpression* InExpression, int32 InOutputIndex, const FGuid& InMaterialAttributeID, bool bInCompilingPreviousFrameKey) :
2072 Expression(InExpression),
2073 OutputIndex(InOutputIndex),
2074 MaterialAttributeID(InMaterialAttributeID),
2075 bCompilingPreviousFrameKey(bInCompilingPreviousFrameKey)
2076 {}
2077
2078
2079 friend bool operator==(const FMaterialExpressionKey& X, const FMaterialExpressionKey& Y)
2080 {
2081 return X.Expression == Y.Expression && X.OutputIndex == Y.OutputIndex && X.MaterialAttributeID == Y.MaterialAttributeID && X.bCompilingPreviousFrameKey == Y.bCompilingPreviousFrameKey;
2082 }
2083
2084 friend uint32 GetTypeHash(const FMaterialExpressionKey& ExpressionKey)
2085 {
2086 return PointerHash(ExpressionKey.Expression);
2087 }
2088};

2091class FMaterialFunctionCompileState
2092{
2093public:
2094 explicit FMaterialFunctionCompileState(UMaterialExpressionMaterialFunctionCall* InFunctionCall)
2095 : FunctionCall(InFunctionCall)
2096 {}
2097
2098 ~FMaterialFunctionCompileState()
2099 {
2100 ClearSharedFunctionStates();
2101 }
2102
2103 FMaterialFunctionCompileState* FindOrAddSharedFunctionState(FMaterialExpressionKey& ExpressionKey, class UMaterialExpressionMaterialFunctionCall* SharedFunctionCall)
2104 {
2105 if (FMaterialFunctionCompileState** ExistingState = SharedFunctionStates.Find(ExpressionKey))
2106 {
2107 return *ExistingState;
2108 }
2109 return SharedFunctionStates.Add(ExpressionKey, new FMaterialFunctionCompileState(SharedFunctionCall));
2110 }
2111
2112 void ClearSharedFunctionStates()
2113 {
2114 for (auto SavedStateIt = SharedFunctionStates.CreateIterator(); SavedStateIt; ++SavedStateIt)
2115 {
2116 FMaterialFunctionCompileState* SavedState = SavedStateIt.Value();
2117 SavedState->ClearSharedFunctionStates();
2118 delete SavedState;
2119 }
2120 SharedFunctionStates.Empty();
2121 }
2122
2123 void Reset()
2124 {
2125 ExpressionStack.Empty();
2126 ExpressionCodeMap.Empty();
2127 ClearSharedFunctionStates();
2128 }
2129
2130 class UMaterialExpressionMaterialFunctionCall* FunctionCall;
2131
2132 // Stack used to avoid re-entry within this function
2133 TArray<FMaterialExpressionKey> ExpressionStack;
2134
2136 TMap<FMaterialExpressionKey,int32> ExpressionCodeMap;
2137
2138 TMap<UMaterialExpression*, int32> ExecExpressionCodeMap;
2139
2140private:
2142 TMap<FMaterialExpressionKey, FMaterialFunctionCompileState*> SharedFunctionStates;
2143};

2191 template<typename TMaterial>
2192 static void DeferredDeleteArray(TArray<TRefCountPtr<TMaterial>>& Materials)
2193 {
2194 if (Materials.Num() > 0)
2195 {
2196 TArray<TRefCountPtr<FMaterial>> MaterialsRenderThread;
2197 for (TRefCountPtr<TMaterial>& Material : Materials)
2198 {
2199 FMaterial* MaterialToDestroy = Material.GetReference();
2200 MaterialToDestroy->PrepareDestroy_GameThread();
2201 MaterialsRenderThread.Emplace(MoveTemp(Material));
2202 }
2203
2204 Materials.Empty();
2205 DeleteMaterialsOnRenderThread(MaterialsRenderThread);
2206 }
2207 }
2208
2209 template<typename TMaterial>
2210 static void DeferredDeleteArray(TArray<TMaterial*>& Materials)
2211 {
2212 if (Materials.Num() > 0)
2213 {
2214 TArray<TRefCountPtr<FMaterial>> MaterialsRenderThread;
2215 for (FMaterial* Material : Materials)
2216 {
2217 Material->PrepareDestroy_GameThread();
2218 MaterialsRenderThread.Emplace(Material);
2219 }
2220
2221 Materials.Empty();
2222 DeleteMaterialsOnRenderThread(MaterialsRenderThread);
2223 }
2224 }

2645 inline bool ShouldCastDynamicShadows() const
2646 {
2647 const EBlendMode BlendMode = GetBlendMode();
2648 return !GetShadingModels().HasOnlyShadingModel(MSM_SingleLayerWater) &&
2649 (IsOpaqueBlendMode(BlendMode)
2650 || IsMaskedBlendMode(BlendMode)

3577class FMaterialResourceMemoryWriter final : public FMemoryWriter
3578{
3579public:
3580 FMaterialResourceMemoryWriter(FArchive& Ar);
3581
3582 virtual ~FMaterialResourceMemoryWriter();
3583
3584 FMaterialResourceMemoryWriter(const FMaterialResourceMemoryWriter&) = delete;
3585 FMaterialResourceMemoryWriter(FMaterialResourceMemoryWriter&&) = delete;
3586 FMaterialResourceMemoryWriter& operator=(const FMaterialResourceMemoryWriter&) = delete;
3587 FMaterialResourceMemoryWriter& operator=(FMaterialResourceMemoryWriter&&) = delete;
3588
3589 virtual FArchive& operator<<(class FName& Name) override;
3590
3591 virtual const FCustomVersionContainer& GetCustomVersions() const override { return ParentAr->GetCustomVersions(); }
3592
3593 virtual FString GetArchiveName() const override { return TEXT("FMaterialResourceMemoryWriter"); }
3594
3595 inline void BeginSerializingMaterialResource()
3596 {
3597 Locs.AddUninitialized();
3598 int64 ResourceOffset = this->Tell();
3599 Locs.Last().Offset = IntCastChecked<uint32>(ResourceOffset);
3600 }
3601
3602 inline void EndSerializingMaterialResource(const FMaterialResource& Resource)
3603 {
3604 static_assert(ERHIFeatureLevel::Num <= 256, "ERHIFeatureLevel doesn't fit into a byte");
3605 static_assert(EMaterialQualityLevel::Num <= 256, "EMaterialQualityLevel doesn't fit into a byte");
3606 check(Resource.GetMaterialInterface());
3607 Locs.Last().FeatureLevel = uint8(Resource.GetFeatureLevel());
3608 Locs.Last().QualityLevel = uint8(Resource.GetQualityLevel());
3609 }
3610
3611private:
3612 TArray<uint8> Bytes;
3613 TArray<FMaterialResourceLocOnDisk> Locs;
3614 TMap<FNameEntryId, int32> Name2Indices;
3615 FArchive* ParentAr;
3616
3617 void SerializeToParentArchive();
3618};

3628 {
3629 check(Ar);
3630 Ar->BeginSerializingMaterialResource();
3631 }
3632
3633 ~FMaterialResourceWriteScope()
3634 {
3635 Ar->EndSerializingMaterialResource(Resource);
3636 }
3637
3638private:
3639 FMaterialResourceMemoryWriter* Ar;
3640 const FMaterialResource& Resource;
3641};
